# Sunny 16 Rule Calculator & Analog Light Meter

> Sunny 16 Rule Calculator is a free, meterless exposure and depth of field calculator pocket guide for 35mm, medium format, and large format analog film photographers.

## Overview
The Sunny 16 rule is an empirical photographic method to calculate accurate daylight exposure without a handheld or in-camera light meter. On a sunny day with distinct shadows, aperture is set to f/16 and shutter speed is the reciprocal of the film's ISO/ASA rating (1/ISO).

## Core Rules & Lighting Conditions
- f/22: Snow, sand, bright sea reflections (+1 stop brighter than sunny)
- f/16: Direct bright sunlight, distinct hard-edged shadows (Base Sunny 16)
- f/11: Slight overcast, soft shadows, haziness
- f/8: Overcast, barely visible shadows
- f/5.6: Heavy overcast, dark clouds, rain, no shadows
- f/4: Open shade, subjects sheltered from direct sky, sunset
- f/2.8: Golden hour, sunset, deep shadows
- f/2: Blue hour, deep twilight
- f/1.4: Bright indoor window light, neon street lighting at night

## Reciprocal Equivalent Exposures
For any lighting condition, increasing the shutter speed by 1 stop requires opening the aperture by 1 stop to maintain constant exposure (EV = constant):
- ISO 400 Sunny 16 Base: f/16 @ 1/500s
- Equivalent 1: f/11 @ 1/1000s
- Equivalent 2: f/8 @ 1/2000s
- Equivalent 3 (with ND / Polarizer): f/2.8 @ 1/1000s (+ ND4 filter)

## Optical Filter Compensation Factors
- Yellow #8 (K2): +1 EV (Filter Factor 2x) — Enhances cloud contrast in B&W
- Orange #16 (G): +2 EV (Filter Factor 4x) — Dramatic skies, cuts atmospheric haze
- Red #25 (A): +3 EV (Filter Factor 8x) — Near-infrared effect, deep black skies
- Green #11 (X1): +2 EV (Filter Factor 4x) — Natural foliage tones, skin portraits
- Circular Polarizer (CPL): +2 EV (Filter Factor 4x) — Cuts reflections, saturates color
- ND4 Filter: +2 EV (Filter Factor 4x) — Allows shooting wide open in bright sun
- ND8 Filter: +3 EV (Filter Factor 8x) — Allows shooting fast lenses (f/1.4 - f/2) in bright sun

## Film Latitude & Push/Pull Processing
- Color Negative (C-41): +2 to +3 stops overexposure latitude, -1 stop underexposure latitude
- Black & White Silver Gelatin: +2 to +3 stops overexposure latitude, -1 stop underexposure latitude
- Color Reversal / Slide (E-6): ±0.5 stop latitude (expose strictly for highlights)
